title: Foreground Theme
description: Seasonal decoration over the mirror: snow, New Year's sparkles, hearts, spring petals, autumn leaves or Halloween embers. Put it in Foreground. Shapes that keep moving keep the Raspberry Pi drawing (warmer, and a video beside it may stutter); showers or still shapes cost next to nothing.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: By date: snow 1 Dec–6 Jan, sparkles 31 Dec–1 Jan, hearts 10–14 Feb, petals April–May, leaves 20 Sep–15 Nov, embers 25–31 Oct, and nothing on other days. Or one theme all year.

mode.title: Movement
mode.description: Now and then: it moves for half a minute, then stands still. All the time looks best and costs the most.

amount.title: How Much
amount.description: Fewer shapes are calmer and lighter for the Pi. How bright: the Opacity setting below.

shower_on_arrival.title: Move When Someone Comes
shower_on_arrival.description: Now and then: it moves when the motion sensor sees someone at the mirror.

shower_every.title: Minutes Between
shower_every.description: Now and then: how often it moves by itself.

drift.title: Snowdrift
drift.description: With snow: a low drift along the bottom edge. It never moves.
